newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche/Merrill lead 2.64 bln FRF securitisation.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche/Merrill lead 2.64 bln FRF securitisation.

text.p: A 2.63854 billion French franc securitisation has been launched in the name of Serail Plc, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Paris, said on Friday as joint lead manager and sole bookrunner.

The deal is secured on a portfolio of bonds issued by French corporates, financial institutions and state-owned entities. It is guaranteed by Financial Security Assurance. Merrill Lynch is the other joint lead manager. Banque Arjil is the arranger.
